Jules (CS): Quick ask for Azimuth demo in APAC tomorrow: can we add their egress CIDRs to the APAC edge allowlist, temporarily raise QPS from 150 -> 500 for 36h, and honor a region header pin `X-Region: ap-sg`? This demo is tied to a renewal conversation in 5 weeks, so prioritize.

Priya (NetOps): Please share CIDRs and exact start time. We'll need an infra change and a scoped override.

Jules (CS): CIDRs: 45.33.22.0/29 and 203.122.10.128/27. Start: 2025-05-10T02:00Z for 36h, auto-revoke at end.

Nora (Solutions): Recommend enabling prefix cache warmup and route-level small-batch config to improve 95th percentile. Add `quant_profile: int8` for reduce latency.

Priya (NetOps): Creating change INFR-9997 to: add the CIDRs to peering ACLs, apply header pin `X-Region: ap-sg`, and set temp qps 500 scoped to route `azimuth-demo`. Staging ETA 90m.

Jules (CS): Sample route snippet to send customer:
```json
{"route":"azimuth-demo","allowlist":["45.33.22.0/29","203.122.10.128/27"],"region_header":"X-Region","region_value":"ap-sg","temp_qps":500,"auto_revoke":"2025-05-11T14:00Z"}
```

infra-bot: INFR-9997 created by priya.net 1: status queued. Change window 2025-05-10T02:00Z -> 2025-05-11T14:00Z. Runbook: /runbooks/azimuth-apac-demo.md.

Priya (NetOps): Applied to staging, smoke tests passed (routing/TLS/metrics). Will roll to prod at scheduled time and monitor.

Tom (AM): I'll note the renewal risk and let commercial know we'll offer a trial uplift plan if they need sustained capacity.

Jules (CS): I'll schedule a 20m enablement call for 10:30 PT to walk them through header pin and cache warmup. Closing internal loop after prod change completes.
